supersedes: configs/v3/spectral.json (Step 3, per-epoch aggregation); its outputs are kept for comparison

psd.note: Full 4 s (2000-sample) epoch: 0.25 Hz bin spacing; 1 Hz full bandwidth -> NW = 2, 3 tapers.

band_rule: Half-open bins lo <= f < hi; band power = sum of PSD over the band's bins x bin width.
pairs_note: The 11 analysed homologous pairs (22 channels; Fp1/Fp2 and midline excluded), left channel first.

features.AI: (L - R) / (L + R) of averaged-spectrum band power
features.LR: ln(L) - ln(R) of averaged-spectrum band power
features.mabsAI: mean of absAI over the available pairs, per band (averaged spectrum)
features.pdBSI: mean over available pairs and over PSD bins 1 <= f < 25 Hz of |(R - L) / (R + L)| on the averaged spectrum (van Putten 2007)
features.DAR: delta / alpha power of the averaged spectrum summed over the available analysed channels
features.DTABR: (delta + theta) / (alpha + beta) power of the averaged spectrum summed over the available analysed channels

aggregation: Step 3b (deviation D15): for each class, 100 draws of exactly 10 epochs (the per-class minimum) without replacement; each draw's multitaper PSDs are averaged, and every feature (AI, LR, absAI, mabsAI, pdBSI per 0.25 Hz bin over 1-25 Hz, DAR, DTABR) is computed on that averaged spectrum; the class value is the median over draws; the subject value is the mean of the two class values (D6). Every subject uses the same 10 epochs per class, so the noise floor is equal across subjects.
missing_rule: A pair is NaN (no imputation) when either channel is in the epochs' info['bads'] (unavailable pair) or when both of its channels were interpolated at any stage (continuous-stage 'interpolated' or rule-iii 'screen_interpolated' in epoch_qc). Cross-pair features (mabsAI, pdBSI, DAR, DTABR) use the remaining pairs; the number used is recorded in the QC file.

lesion.rule: Approved lesion-alignment step (the only code that reads lesion side). For included subjects with a certain side: ipsilesional minus contralesional, i.e. les_AI = AI and les_LR = LR for a left lesion, and both sign-flipped for a right lesion; les_meanAI = mean of les_AI over available pairs. |AI| is sign-free and is not repeated. Subjects with an uncertain side have no row in the lesion table.

epoch_count_check: Label-free: Spearman rho of every feature with n_epochs_kept and with the smaller class count, across included subjects; reported, not used for any choice.

subsample.seed_rule: seed = 42 + zero-based subject index in the Figshare numbering (sub-01 -> 42, sub-50 -> 91); one numpy default_rng per subject, draws taken class by class (left_hand, then right_hand)

noise_floor_note: Per-epoch, per-bin |BSI| for statistically identical hemispheres with 3 tapers is about 0.31 (chi2(6) power ratios); averaging 10 epochs per spectrum lowers it to about 0.10.
